base.description: Bright premium painterly Los Angeles, broad readable district masses, connected roads, mountain/skyline backdrop, quieter central object slots. No text, customers, lanterns, locks, destruction or pests baked in. Match approved perspective and light direction. Rejected neutral-atlas-draft.png is not an approved substitute.

registration.geography: worldAnchor remains the existing Mercator projection of canonical WGS84; display percentages are art-directed and must not be used for membership or GPS.
registration.maskUsage: Existing canonical masks are provenance/reference only. V6 plates use the authored display footprint, not the unshifted GIS crop.
registration.plateAlpha: RGBA PNG with straight alpha. Opaque terrain/building core covers the old landscape; feather the perimeter over 48–96 pixels into genuine transparency. No rectangular matte, drop shadow, baked color wash, or duplicate pests.
registration.continuity: All four states for a territory share pixel dimensions, camera, skyline/building registration, road entry/exit positions, horizon, light direction and pivot. Plate translation follows the compositor group. Inspect transitions at 100% and label-hidden state at all target viewports.
registration.forbidden: Do not turn a state plate into a large rat/building sticker. Transform the perceived ground and neighborhood. No labels, counts, customer lanterns, major locks, UI or business facts baked into artwork.
